comment: v7 genre-shard manifest: a layer is a WORLD (prepped alone, poisoning nothing); the glue is dead (links 1150→620 measured). The layered state (frozen base + genre sessions) turns these worlds into one mind; until the L-1 seam lands, each world answers its own tiers. Each world declares its TEXT KIND: «shows» is generated show-material whose every claim is checkable, «prose» is essay corpus where a hyphen lives inside a name, a power lives in a superscript and a falsehood may be QUOTED to be refuted. A judge calibrated on shows produces false accusations on prose, so jurisdiction is declared, not assumed.
external_root_comment: Worlds whose file does not resolve inside this repository are looked up here: the prose corpora are built by the architecture repository's own pipeline, and copying them would create a second source of one fact. Override with GENESIS_EXTERNAL_ROOT.

worlds.name: abs
worlds.genre: THE MODULUS OF A NUMBER — THE DISTANCE TO ZERO, WHICH HAS NO SIGN. Measured 11.09 across the 237 show worlds: the writing «|−5|» — NONE; «distance from zero» — NONE. The word «модуль» occurs 2540 times and ALWAYS ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE: it is the remainder modulo n («7 по модулю 2 равно 1»), the arithmetic of residues, not the size of a number. Another 297 times the modulus is read in the world of formula notation, but in LaTeX and as THE NAME OF A SIGN, not as a number. A WORD OCCUPIED BY ANOTHER CONCEPT IS NOT A SHOWN CONCEPT. This house closes the signed area with a fourth member and gives a name to what three earlier houses showed without one: the house of order measured STEPS TO THE LEFT OF ZERO, the house of signed addition showed that opposites sum to zero — and both spoke of the DISTANCE TO ZERO. Its name is the modulus. WHAT IS SHOWN THRICE WITHOUT A NAME MUST BE GIVEN A NAME, OR THE READER WILL NOT RECOGNISE IT THE FOURTH TIME. Four genera: DISTANCE («|−5| = 5: from −5 to zero there are 5 steps, and from 5 to zero just as many»); EQUAL MODULI («|−5| = |5|, although −5 and 5 are different numbers»); THE MODULUS OF A SUM («|−5 + 3| = 2, and |−5| + |3| = 8: the modulus of a sum is not the sum of moduli») — the tenth trap of the series: the action and the modulus DO NOT COMMUTE, and a reader used to opening brackets term by term will open this one too and get eight instead of two; ORDER («−5 is less than −2, although |−5| is greater than |−2|: farther to the left means less») — a seam with the house of order and its second trap: the smaller number has the GREATER modulus. The second genus states the boundary of the reverse move: equality of moduli is NOT equality of numbers — the modulus loses the sign, and from «five steps to zero» it does not follow in which direction. The sign of the modulus is the plain bar «|», and the number inside is written with the minus «−», as in the whole signed area of the corpus.

worlds.name: action_measure
worlds.genre: ACTION MEASURE — the number that MEASURES the act, not counts the goods, and the number that counts the BEARERS, not the things. Named by d5 on the live SVAMP band (05.09): of 726 tacts, 46 carry a measured act («jumped 12 inches», «weighed 5 pounds») and 130 a number before the subject («6 birds were sitting on the fence. 4 more birds came») — 112 of them are held by NOTHING a frame «actor — verb — number — goods» can read. The house declares what the band showed and nothing beyond: two verbs of measure (jump — length, weigh — weight) with their units and count forms, sums of two measures with their ledger, bearers with an arrival and a departure. THE UNIT BELONGS TO THE VERB: «jumped 12 pounds» is a lie by unit before any number is checked. Every page carries its question. Two languages, as its sibling measure_story; the world is closed (courts/action_measure_court.py).

worlds.name: action_measure_langs
worlds.genre: ACTION MEASURE IN SEVEN MORE LANGUAGES (d5's genus, the owner's word: every language in surplus) — «der Frosch sprang 12 Zentimeter. wie weit sprang der Frosch? 12 Zentimeter.», «la grenouille a sauté de 12 centimètres.», «żaba skoczyła na 12 centymetrów.», the sum of two measures, and the bearers at a place with an arrival or a departure («auf dem Zaun saßen 6 Vögel. 4 weitere Vögel kamen dazu.», «na płocie siedziało 6 ptaków. przyleciały jeszcze 4 ptaki.») in de/fr/es/it/pt/nl/pl. The unit belongs to the verb; count forms of units and bearers are declared (Polish three, Romance two, German and Dutch one) and chosen by the pack's rule; the Polish verb of the bearers bends with the count form. Frames declared per language, read by the court through the same tables (tools/measurelangs.py). CLOSED world.

worlds.name: action_pages
worlds.genre: A LEDGER FOR EVERY COUNTABLE ACT — NEW PAGES, OLD WORLDS UNTOUCHED (the collegium of a hundred per cent, owner 03.09; holon's first task, e9's condition «add new pages, do not rewrite old ones»): the reader's worlds answer computable questions with a value («peter keeps 4 coins»), and their form may not change because his markets buy skeletons from those lines; so the same genera come again WITH THE CHAIN, in en/ru/de — the remainder «peter had 8 coins. peter gave 4 coins away. how many coins are left? 8 − 4 = 4. so the answer is 4.», the increase «nick had 9 balls. nick got 2 balls more. … 9 + 2 = 11.», the share that went «у Анны было 70 книг. половина книг ушла. сколько книг осталось? 70 ÷ 2 = 35, 70 − 35 = 35.» and «две трети книг ушли … 60 ÷ 3 = 20, 20 × 2 = 40, 60 − 40 = 20.» (the words of the fractions from the house of shares, the Russian verb agreeing with the numerator), the two bearers «elena has 2 children. ava has 3 children. how many children do they have together? 2 + 3 = 5.», the multiple «Anna hat 2 Eier. Jonas hat dreimal so viele Eier wie Anna. … 3 × 2 = 6.»; ≥ 15 pages per genus and language; the house (tools/actionpages.py) holds the templates, the court regenerates the page letter by letter

worlds.name: actturn
worlds.genre: THE DIALOGUE ACT — the organism's own turn, with confirmation and observation (06.09). Asked for by holon for the release demo's sixth scene, and it is the one show the corpus never had: every world SAYS what the world is and none shows the organism ACTING in it. A turn is four replies, not one: the user's ORDER, the organism's PROPOSAL with a question about it, the user's word, and only then the REPORT — with the folder COUNTED AGAIN. Five frames, each sealed by a number: the done act («3 + 1 = 4»), the REFUSAL where the count is unchanged («3 = 3» — a refusal that changed the world would be a lie visible in arithmetic), the two impossible acts (the file is already there; the file is not there), and the act that happens and the count cannot see it (reading and editing: «3 = 3» after a DONE act — the frame that separates «nothing happened» from «something happened the count cannot see»). The court also refuses a turn the world does not allow, demands ONE act and ONE file per turn, and catches a report that carries no confirmation at all (tools/actturn.py). CLOSED world.

worlds.name: goal
worlds.genre: THE GOAL SPOKEN IN SPEECH, NOT TYPED AS A COMMAND (14.09, asked for by omega-ad). The organism already reaches a goal on the world's ledger by itself — it reads, searches the world's declaration, proposes, waits for a word, acts and checks by reading again — but the goal was handed to it as «/goal wire angle = 30», and speech about a goal the corpus never showed. THREE COMPARISONS ARE THREE GENERA, and each is a deed: «bring the angle to 30» (=), «bring the power to at least 40» (≥), «keep the temperature at most 30» (≤). Three outcomes are BRANCHES inside a comparison, not genera — «I propose … yes … set», «it already holds, no move is needed» and «read only» are three answers to ONE request, told apart by the state of the world and not by speech. The fourth genus stands apart: THE WORD REFUSES. There the ledger and the comparison are both right and the WORD cancels the move, and the world stays as it was — «before 0, now 0». NO TRANSLATION TABLE ANYWHERE: the ledger's name is what the world itself declares, a Russian device declares «угол» and a German one «Winkel», and the reader checks the word of the proposal against the word of the declaration, not against a foreign dictionary. Nine languages, 783 pages, every one sealed by an observation the court recomputes.

worlds.name: equalshare
worlds.genre: DIVISION AS AN ACT WITHOUT A BEARER (14.09, asked for by holon-f9). The key's «поровну» family was MUTE ENTIRELY — eighteen lines of eighteen — and the reason was measured, not guessed: in the whole corpus division lives WITH A BEARER and WITH GOODS («Иван разделил 6 книг поровну между 2 друзьями»), while the key asks it bare: «раздели 14 на 2 поровну. что получится?» — no person, no thing, no scene, and the answer DISTRIBUTIVE («по 7») rather than a number. A FORM THAT LIVES IN THE CORPUS ONLY WITH A BEARER IS NOT BOUGHT WITHOUT ONE. Three genera by deed: exact division («по 7»); division with a remainder, where the remainder is NAMED and not dropped («по 4, и 2 останется» — a world silent about the remainder teaches that there is none); and division into zero parts, refused WITH A GROUND («на ноль делить нельзя: доли не выйдет ни одной»). Two surfaces alternate by index — with the question word («что получится?») for the market of question frames, and as a bare pair («раздели 14 на 2 поровну: по 7.») for the market of acts without a bearer. Nine languages; where the name of the part agrees with the number (Polish: 2…4 nominative, else genitive), the court judges the agreement too.

worlds.name: dyck
worlds.genre: THE ROW THAT MUST BE CLOSED (14.09, rung two of the ladder, asked for by holon-f9 for BBH's `dyck_languages`). The corpus showed brackets only as a SIGN INSIDE A FORMULA; a row that must be CLOSED it never showed once. A BRACKET IN A FORMULA IS A SIGN BESIDE NUMBERS; A BRACKET IN A ROW IS MEMORY OF WHAT WAS OPENED — two different skills, and the corpus taught the second with nothing. Three genera by deed: the TAIL («( [ { } ] — how is it closed? ) » — write exactly what closes what is open, in reverse order, and the answer SHOWS the stack rather than guessing it); BALANCED OR NOT (yes with the number of pairs, no with the number left open); and DEPTH (the number the stack held at its deepest — the row's memory as a number, without which closing is guessing). The rows are built BY A STACK, so every show is true by construction; the court trusts no construction and counts the stack again.

worlds.name: boolexpr
worlds.genre: BOOLEAN EXPRESSIONS — THE ORDER OF STEPS, NOT ONE STEP (14.09, rung two, asked for by holon-f9 for BBH's `boolean_expressions`). The corpus knew the connectives only as a TABLE («T ∧ T = T» in the world of logic and sets) and never showed an EXPRESSION where there are several and their order decides everything. A TABLE OF A CONNECTIVE TEACHES ONE STEP; AN EXPRESSION TEACHES THE ORDER OF STEPS — and the second follows from the first by nothing: «not True and False» is False while «not ( True and False )» is True, and the table is silent about that. Three genera by deed: ONE CONNECTIVE over literals; TWO CONNECTIVES WITHOUT BRACKETS, where precedence decides (not > and > or, declared and not implied); and BRACKETS THAT CHANGE THE ANSWER, where both sides stand side by side — otherwise the reader learns that brackets mean nothing. Four bracket shapes, not one: a bracket that changes the answer only under «not» would teach that under «and» and «or» it is idle. The court does not know the tree the house built: it parses the WRITING by precedence and computes the value itself.

worlds.name: alphaorder
worlds.genre: ALPHABETICAL ORDER — THE ORDER OF THE LETTERS, DECLARED AND NOT TAKEN FROM THE ENCODING (14.09, rung two, asked for by holon-f9 for BBH's `word_sorting`). Measured against the свод that day: lines containing «по алфавиту» or «alphabetical» — ZERO. The world `orderforms` puts NUMBERS in order and knows «по возрастанию»; that LETTERS also have an order, and that it does not follow from counting, the corpus said nowhere. THE ORDER OF THE LETTERS IS DECLARED, NOT TAKEN FROM THE ENCODING: in Unicode «ё» (U+0451) stands AFTER «я» (U+044F), so anyone sorting strings by codepoint gets «ящик, ёлка» and calls it the alphabet — one of the court's planted falsehoods is exactly that mistake. Three genera by WHERE THE ORDER IS DECIDED: distinct first letters (decided at step one); a shared head, where the decision slides to the second letter and further; and A WORD INSIDE A WORD («дом, дома, домик»), where the letters never diverge and THE END OF THE WORD decides — the shorter goes first. The third is where letter-by-letter comparison is silent by itself, and so it is a genus and not a case of the second. A nest is three words and gives five shows: every permutation EXCEPT the already-correct one, because a show with nothing to reorder teaches copying the answer off the question.

worlds.name: handover
worlds.genre: TRACKING THINGS THROUGH SWAPS (14.09, rung two, asked for by holon-f9 for BBH's `tracking_shuffled_objects`). Measured against the свод that day: lines containing «меняются», «обменял», «swap» or «traded» — ZERO. The corpus knew that a thing PASSES («ann gave away 1 coin») and counted the remainder, but not the SWAP, where nothing is created or lost and only the hand changes. COUNTING A REMAINDER AND TRACKING A THING ARE DIFFERENT DEEDS: in the first the thing is faceless and its QUANTITY matters; in the second there is one thing, the quantity never changes, and only WHERE it is matters — the second follows from subtraction by nothing. Three genera by WHAT THE ANSWER DEMANDS: PAST (no swap touched the one asked about, so the answer is the BEGINNING — and a reader who learned «named means changed» fails here); ONE SWAP (the answer is the partner's starting thing); and A CHAIN (the state must be carried forward, because by the time of their swap the partner no longer holds what they started with). The same swap done twice belongs to the chain: the things come back, and «named twice» does not mean «changed twice». The genus is READ OFF THE DEED, not assigned: the house walks every declared run of swaps and every person asked, then looks at what came out and names the genus by that. The things are declared in the ACCUSATIVE, because the frame stands on «держит» — «мяч» and «ключ» coincide with the nominative and «книгу», «ленту» do not, which is exactly why the form is declared and not cut off an ending.

worlds.name: nestcalc
worlds.genre: MULTI-STEP ARITHMETIC — THE PATH, NOT ONLY THE TOTAL (14.09, rung two, asked for by holon-f9 for BBH's `multistep_arithmetic_two`). Measured against the свод that day: lines with A BRACKET INSIDE A BRACKET — ZERO. A bracket with two signs the corpus has (334 lines, «(8 + 5) + 3 × 8 = 45»), a nested one not once; and nowhere is it said IN WHAT ORDER the steps go — only the total is said. THE TOTAL IS NOT THE PATH: «((3 + 5) × 2) − 7 = 9» is true and teaches nothing, because it does not show what was counted first. This world names THE STEPS — «сначала 3 + 5 = 8, потом 8 × 2 = 16, потом 16 − 7 = 9» — and every step is a number checkable on its own, by the same law under which the world of the plan demands a step end in a checkable number. Three genera by WHAT DECIDES THE ORDER OF STEPS: a bracket inside a bracket (inward, then outward, then the rest); two independent brackets counted apart and only then joined; and a bracket plus PRECEDENCE («×» before «−»), where a reader counting left to right gets a different number and sees it here. The court checks both: the expression is re-parsed by precedence, and every step must be arithmetically true, must take BOTH its operands either from the expression's own numbers or from earlier steps' results, the count of steps must equal the count of signs, and the last result must equal the stated answer. A step that took a number from nowhere is a lie even when the total agrees. A declared boundary: the numbers are small and no step goes below zero — negatives exist in the corpus (464 lines) but they are another deed, and mixing them with the order of steps would teach two things at once.

worlds.name: drop
worlds.genre: A PASSAGE AND A QUESTION TO IT — DROP AS ONE WORLD (14.09, rung two, asked for by holon-f9 in exactly this shape: «span plus arithmetic, one world»). The DROP market puts questions OF DIFFERENT NATURE to one passage, and that is the whole point: one answer LIES IN THE TEXT and must be copied out, another is WRITTEN NOWHERE in it and must be computed. Splitting the genera into separate worlds would stop being DROP, because the market stands on the reader NOT KNOWING IN ADVANCE which kind of question was asked. THE ANSWER THAT IS IN THE TEXT AND THE ANSWER THAT IS NOT ARE DIFFERENT DEEDS: the first is a CHOICE among what is written, the second a COUNT over it. The corpus could do each apart, but nowhere put them to THE SAME passage, and so nowhere taught TELLING THEM APART. One passage, six questions, three genera: SPAN (the answer is a word of the passage, copied letter for letter), COUNT (no answer in the passage, but no arithmetic either — count the ones that fit) and DIFFERENCE (the answer cannot be in the passage: it is born of subtracting two written numbers). The months stand in the nominative and only there, because a span answer must be a word of the passage letter for letter — say «в марте» in the passage and «март» in the answer and the genus lies by its own name. A declared boundary: the numbers end in 0 or 5, so the noun after them is always genitive plural — numeral agreement is the deed of ANOTHER house (`numnounforms`), and mixing two deeds in one show teaches both by halves.

worlds.name: bicond
worlds.genre: THE TWO-WAY LINK — «only if», «if and only if», NECESSARY AND SUFFICIENT (14.09). Measured against the свод of 447 283 lines that day: «тогда и только тогда» / «if and only if» — ZERO lines; «только если» / «only if» — ZERO; «необходимое условие» and «достаточное условие» — ZERO and ZERO. Meanwhile the world of inference (`inferforms`) teaches in 162 shows that CONVERTING AN IMPLICATION IS AN ERROR: «6 is divisible by 2. does it follow that 6 is divisible by 4? no». THE CORPUS CALLS THE CONVERSE AN ERROR ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-TWO TIMES AND NEVER ONCE SHOWS WHEN IT IS RIGHT. A reader who learned «one does not infer the premise from the consequent» will fail exactly where the link is TWO-WAY — and such are every divisibility rule, every definition, and every «if and only if». A prohibition without its boundary teaches not caution but blindness. Three genera by deed: ONE WAY (refuse the backward step and prove the refusal BY EXAMPLE); BOTH WAYS (walk the link in both directions where the one-way link refuses — the divisibility rules live here: the digit sum is divisible by 3 IF AND ONLY IF the number is); and NECESSARY/SUFFICIENT (name WHICH OF THE TWO HALVES holds). ONE-WAYNESS IS PROVED BY AN EXAMPLE, TWO-WAYNESS BY WALKING THE WHOLE DECLARED RANGE: the house does not declare the kind of link in words — it derives it by walking `РЯД` entire, and refuses to build a page whose kind disagrees. The court does the same, apart. The number named on the page must BE that example and not any number at all: «take 2 — it is divisible by 2 but not by 4» is true, «take 8» is a lie, though 8 is also divisible by 2.

worlds.name: grid
worlds.genre: READING A TABLE — TWO COORDINATES, NOT TWO LOOKUPS IN A ROW (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured against the свод of 447 451 lines: «на пересечении» / «at the intersection of» — ZERO lines. The word «таблица» is in the свод 3 085 times and «ячейка» 710, but ALWAYS as the NAME OF SOMETHING ELSE — a table of a connective, of cases, of measures — and never once as a DEED: here is a table, here are two coordinates, name the number. The passage world (`passagedrop`) holds ONE coordinate, a name against a number; here there are two names and neither gives an answer by itself. Three genera by WHERE THE READING GOES: INTERSECTION (two coordinates inward, and the answer LIES in the table); TOTAL (no answer in the table — it is born of adding a whole row or column); and BACKWARD (given the value, the coordinate is asked — and here a reader who learned the inward move cannot move at all). A QUESTION WITH TWO ANSWERS IS NOT A QUESTION: the backward reading is built only where the value is UNIQUE in its column, and a table where one number stands twice in a column yields fewer pages — which is right, for the second would be a lie wearing the face of truth. The court refuses such a page even when the row named does carry the number.

worlds.name: roundneed
worlds.genre: ROUNDING THAT THE DEED DECIDES (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured against the свод of 447 451 lines: rounding UP is there — 77 lines of «коробок нужно» and 77 of «are needed»; rounding DOWN — «сколько целых» / «how many whole» — ZERO and ZERO; and the two sides on ONE page — nowhere. The rounding world (`roundforms`) rounds a NUMBER to tens by nearness, a rule that lives inside the number itself. Here the rounding does not live in the number: ONE DIVISION, TWO ANSWERS, AND IT IS NOT THE NUMBER THAT DECIDES BUT THE DEED. «Passengers 95, a bus holds 40: 3 buses are wanted». «Cloth 95, a dress takes 40: 2 dresses come out». The same 95 ÷ 40 = 2 remainder 15, and the answers differ — because in the first the remainder DEMANDS one more container, and in the second it is LEFT OVER and yields no whole thing. Three genera: UP, DOWN, and BOTH SIDE BY SIDE — the same dividend, the same divisor, both answers on one page, and what separates them said aloud. Without the third genus the first two would teach two turns of speech («нужно» and «выйдет») rather than one deed. A ZERO REMAINDER ERASES THE DIFFERENCE: on such numbers both answers coincide, so the up and down genera do not take them and the court refuses such a page; the third genus takes them DELIBERATELY and says the two sides agree — the boundary is shown, not passed over.

worlds.name: datecmp
worlds.genre: COMPARING TWO DATES — A KEY WHOSE FIELDS HAVE DIFFERENT WEIGHTS (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured against the свод of 447 451 lines: «какая дата» / «which date» — ZERO. The word «раньше» is there 152 times, but all of it is the TIME OF DAY — «left in the morning and arrived in the afternoon»; which of two DATES is earlier the corpus says nowhere. The date world (`dateforms`, 480 shows) can count forwards and backwards across the edge of a month and never once COMPARES. A DATE HAS THREE NUMBERS AND THEIR WEIGHTS DIFFER: the year is heavier than the month, the month than the day, and THE HEAVIEST OF THE DIFFERING ONES decides. «31 december 2023 is earlier than 1 january 2024» although 31 is greater than 1: the day decides nothing here, because the year diverged — and a reader who compares the first number they see fails exactly here. This is the same law as in the alphabet world and a different one: there the composite key is by PLACE («дом» before «дома», the letters having run out), here by WEIGHT. Place and weight are different things, and so the world is separate. Three genera by WHAT DECIDED: the year, the month, the day. AN ANSWER WITHOUT ITS REASON IS NOT AN ANSWER: the page names not only the earlier date but WHAT decided, and saying «the day decides» where the year diverged is a lie even when the date named is right. The court rebuilds the page entire and matches it letter for letter.

worlds.name: letterwork
worlds.genre: DEEDS UPON LETTERS — A WORD AS A ROW, NOT ONLY AS A MEANING (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured against the свод of 447 451 lines: «палиндром» / «palindrome» — ZERO, «анаграмма» / «anagram» — ZERO, a shift of letters — ZERO. The letters world (`letters`, 360 shows) can COUNT the letters of a word («сколько букв в слове „кот“? 3: к, о, т») and only count them. A WORD IS A ROW OF LETTERS, NOT ONLY A MEANING: the corpus knew the word by meaning (translation, morphology, definition) and by length, but that the row can be TURNED, SORTED and SHIFTED it showed nowhere. All three deeds ask nothing of the sense: «шалаш» is a palindrome not because it is a hut. Three genera: BACKWARDS (read the row right to left and compare it with itself), SAME LETTERS (compare two words by their SET of letters and not by order — and the negative case is PROVED on the page, naming the letter that is in one and not the other), and SHIFT (move every letter N places along the alphabet — here a letter becomes a NUMBER, its place in the declared row). The alphabet is taken from the alphabetical-order world and not declared a second time: two similar declarations drift apart silently, one has nothing to drift from. THE ALPHABET IS CLOSED INTO A RING: the shift carries «я» past the end and it returns to the start — the same CARRY as in clocks and dates, only its base is 33 and not 60 or 12. A page where the carry happened says so aloud, and the court refuses both silence about a carry that happened and a claim of one that did not.

worlds.name: whodwells
worlds.genre: SEATING BY CONSTRAINTS — SIMULTANEITY, NOT A CHAIN OF STEPS (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured against the свод: «кто где живёт» / «who lives where» — ZERO lines. The inference world (`inferforms`) holds ONE move — from a premise, a consequence; the strict-inference world knows ponens, tollens and two fallacies. But INFERENCE FROM SEVERAL CONSTRAINTS AT ONCE, where no single one decides anything, the corpus showed nowhere. ONE MOVE AND AN INTERSECTION OF PROHIBITIONS ARE DIFFERENT DEEDS: modus ponens takes one premise and makes one step; here no constraint gives an answer alone, and the answer is born of WHAT IS LEFT when every prohibition is laid over the others. This is not a long chain of steps but SIMULTANEITY. Three genera by WHAT THE CONSTRAINTS CUT WITH: pure prohibition («X is not in the first»), pure order («X is to the right of Y»), and MIXED — where NEITHER KIND DECIDES ALONE, which the house VERIFIES rather than declares: remove the prohibitions and more than one seating remains; remove the relations and the same. A PROBLEM WITH TWO SOLUTIONS IS NOT A PROBLEM: the house builds a page only where the seating is UNIQUE, and the court walks all six seatings to check it. AN EXCESS CONSTRAINT TEACHES NOTHING: a set from which a constraint can be dropped with the seating still unique is not taken — a spare constraint teaches that constraints may go unread, and a reader who learns that will miss where there are no spares. Mixed sets are taken only as PAIRS: there were seven times more mixed triples than pure sets, which is their NUMBER and not their importance, and a mixed triple is a mixed pair plus a third constraint already shown in the pure genera.

worlds.name: pctchain
worlds.genre: TWO PERCENTS IN A ROW (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «процент от процента» / «percent of a percent» — ZERO lines. The percent world takes ONE percent of a number; what happens when a percent is taken TWICE the corpus says nowhere — and that is exactly where everyone errs. PERCENTS DO NOT ADD, BECAUSE THE SECOND IS TAKEN OF A DIFFERENT NUMBER: «minus ten and another minus ten» is minus nineteen, the second tenth taken off 180 and not off 200; and «plus ten, then minus ten» DOES NOT COME BACK. Three genera: they do not add, it does not come back, and THE ORDER DOES NOT MATTER — the positive side of the same law, since multiplication commutes. THE MISTAKE IS NAMED ON THE PAGE, NOT WALKED AROUND: the page says «it became 162» and also «and not 160», and the court demands the naive answer be computed correctly AS NAIVE and DIFFER from the true one — where it coincides there is no mistake to show. A declared boundary: only numbers where EVERY step is whole.

worlds.name: roadpath
worlds.genre: A PATH ALONG ROADS — CONNECTION PASSES ON, NEARNESS DOES NOT (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «как пройти от» / «how to get from» — ZERO lines. The corpus knows DISTANCE (the world of speed and path), ORDER (alphabet, dates) and the LINK OF TWO (the two-way link), but a NETWORK of links, where one place is reached THROUGH another, it knows nowhere. «A is joined to B» and «B to C» gives «from A one can reach C» — but not «A is joined to C»: a reader who learned connection as a property of a PAIR will not walk two steps. Three genera: DIRECTLY (the road is there), THROUGH (no direct road but a path exists — the SHORTEST is named and named entire) and NOT AT ALL, where the deed is to REFUSE and prove the refusal: the whole circle of places reachable from the start is named. A REFUSAL WITHOUT ITS CIRCLE IS A WORD, NOT AN ARGUMENT. And a question with two answers is not a question: the THROUGH genus is built only where the shortest path is UNIQUE.

worlds.name: cooccur
worlds.genre: COINCIDENCE AND CAUSE — NUMBERS SAY WHAT WAS AND ARE SILENT ON WHY (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «совпадение, а не причина» / «correlation is not» — ZERO lines. The corpus can ask «why?» and answer with a ground, but that FROM THE JOINT MOVEMENT OF TWO NUMBERS A CAUSE DOES NOT FOLLOW it says nowhere — and that is the first thing anyone who reads numbers is taught. «Both rose» is a FACT and is checked by subtraction; «one raised the other» is a CAUSE and follows from those same numbers by nothing. The house shows the first and REFUSES the second, and that refusal is the main thing it teaches. Three genera: both rose; they diverged (one rose, the other fell — the refusal is the same and the arithmetic is not, so the reader does not learn that a cause is refused only under agreeing movement); and A THIRD, which rose along with both and is named — then the refusal is STRONGER, for there is something to explain both at once. THE COURT COUNTS FACTS AND DOES NOT JUDGE CAUSES: it checks the numbers, the differences and the direction, and matches the refusal against the DECLARED wording without deciding whether it is right — a cause cannot be checked by subtraction, and an instrument that undertook to check one would lie about its own power.

worlds.name: notenough
worlds.genre: NOT ENOUGH DATA — THE DEAREST ZERO OF THE DAY (14.09). Measured against the свод of 448 335 lines: «лишнее число в задаче» / «is not needed for the answer» — 63 lines, THERE; «данных не хватает» / «cannot be determined» — ZERO. THE CORPUS TAUGHT DISCARDING THE SUPERFLUOUS AND NEVER ONCE TAUGHT STOPPING. A reader for whom every problem is solvable answers where there IS no answer, and answers confidently, because there is nothing for that confidence to break against. This is not a gap in arithmetic but a gap in HONESTY, and it is more dangerous than any arithmetical error, because an arithmetical error can be seen. Three genera: ENOUGH (the data determine the answer and it is given — the genus is needed not for completeness but because without it the reader learns to REFUSE ALWAYS, which is the same trouble from the other end); NOT ENOUGH (the needed number is absent and the page names EXACTLY IT: «it is not said how many were given away»); and SUPERFLUOUS (a number not needed for the answer, with the answer given and the extra NAMED as extra, so the reader does not learn that every number in a problem must enter the count). A REFUSAL WITHOUT NAMING WHAT IS MISSING IS EVASION: anyone can say «unknown»; only one who has read the problem can say what is not in it. The court decides for itself whether the data suffice and matches its decision against the page — a refusal where the data suffice is a lie exactly as much as an answer where they do not.

worlds.name: onecase
worlds.genre: ONE CASE — WHAT AN EXAMPLE IS WORTH (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «пример не доказывает» / «one example does not prove» — ZERO lines, against 6 about a counterexample. The corpus shows examples by the thousand and never once says what an example is WORTH. ONE CASE DOES NOT PROVE A GENERAL CLAIM AND REFUTES IT ENTIRELY. This is NOT a symmetry: to affirm «every» the whole range is needed; to fell it, one is enough. A reader who learned «an example is an argument» will affirm from one case; one who learned «an example is not an argument» will not refute even from a hundred. AND THERE IS A THIRD THING THAT DISSOLVES THE APPARENT CONTRADICTION: on a DECLARED FINITE RANGE, walking the whole range IS a proof. The asymmetry lives not in the logic of the example but in the INFINITY of the domain; name the domain finite and walk it, and «every» is proved. Three genera: an example that fits and proves nothing; a counterexample that fells the claim; and a walk of the whole range with the count of checked numbers named — «all were checked» without the count is a word and not a walk. The properties and the range are taken from the two-way-link world and not declared a second time; the FALSE pairs are the CONVERSES of its one-way links, which is exactly where the two worlds meet.

worlds.name: spread
worlds.genre: THE MEAN AND THE SPREAD — WHAT ONE NUMBER ABOUT MANY LOSES (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «среднее скрывает разброс» / «the average hides» — ZERO lines. The world of the average COMPUTES the mean and does it well; what the mean HIDES the corpus says nowhere — and it is precisely by that that the mean is abused. A MEAN IS ONE NUMBER ABOUT MANY AND IT LOSES THEIR DIFFERENCES: two rows with the SAME mean can diverge as widely as you like; two rows with the same SPREAD can stand as far apart as you like; and worst of all, a mean can be a number NOBODY HAS — «the mean is 4» for the row 1, 1, 10 is true and describes no one. Three genera: the mean is the same and the spreads differ; the spreads are the same and the means differ; and the mean is not any of the row's numbers. BOTH NUMBERS ARE NAMED AND BOTH ARE CHECKABLE: the house does not say «the mean deceives» — that would be an opinion and no court could check it. It puts two recomputable numbers side by side and the difference shows itself. A declared boundary: every row's mean is whole — a fractional mean is another deed and lives in the world of the unit fraction.

worlds.name: noanswer
worlds.genre: TWO REFUSALS, AND WHAT SEPARATES THEM (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe and REBUILT THE SAME HOUR, when the zero turned out to be a zero of WORDS and not of DEEDS). The history of this world is its main lesson. The probe said «деление на ноль» — 0 lines, «division by zero» — 0, and a house was bought on that. An hour later the shapes instrument named `zerodivforms` — a house living since earlier days, 346 shows, saying exactly the same in OTHER WORDS: «сколько будет 4 ÷ 0? делить 4 на 0 нельзя: 0 × 1 = 0, и 0 × 2 = 0, и ни одно произведение не равно 4». THE ZERO PROBE MEASURES WORDS, NOT DEEDS: a zero of words is not a zero of deed, for a house may do the same thing calling it otherwise, and the probe will not see it. A find of the probe is therefore GROUND TO ASK, NOT LICENCE TO BUILD. Two of this world's three genera repeated `zerodivforms` and were removed the same hour. What remains is what is nowhere: THE DIFFERENCE OF TWO REFUSALS. «12 ÷ 0» has no answer BY NUMBER — there is no number which multiplied by zero would give twelve. «Give away 5 apples out of 3» is impossible NOT BY NUMBER — the number is there and it is −2 — but BY THE WORLD: minus two apples do not exist. A refusal that does not distinguish the two teaches fear of both alike and understanding of neither. Three genera, all about the difference and none about the refusals apart: by number; by the world (with the difference PRODUCED as a number); and both side by side, with what separates them said aloud — without which the first two would teach two prohibitions instead of one distinction.

worlds.name: unitmix
worlds.genre: MEASURES THAT DO NOT REDUCE TO ONE ANOTHER (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «нельзя сложить» / «cannot be added» — ZERO lines; «метры и килограммы» — ZERO. The mixed-measure world (`mixedunits`) can do «2 kg 300 g» and the carry between steps of ONE measure; that there are measures between which there is NO carry at all the corpus says nowhere. A NUMBER WITHOUT A MEASURE IS NOT A QUANTITY: «30» by itself means nothing — 30 cm and 30 m are different things and the second is a hundred times the first. ONLY LIKE MAY BE ADDED, AND THAT IS NOT A RULE OF WRITING BUT A PROPERTY OF THE WORLD: between length and mass there is no factor by which one would become the other, so the refusal here is not a prohibition but a consequence — a reader who learned «add the numbers» will add metres to kilograms and get a number that does not exist. Three genera: reduce and add (same kind, different steps — the factor is NAMED on the page and not implied); cannot be added (different kinds — the refusal says WHAT EACH MEASURES); and the same number under different measures, with how many times they differ named. The steps are declared as NUMBERS and not as names, so «100 cm in a metre» follows by counting and not by memory.

worlds.name: badground
worlds.genre: AN UNFIT GROUND — TRUE AND USELESS AT ONCE (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «круг в доказательстве» / «circular reasoning» — ZERO lines. The inference world names two FORMAL fallacies — converting and denying — and checks them by counting. That a ground can be UNFIT WITHOUT BEING FALSE the corpus says nowhere. A GROUND CAN BE TRUE AND USELESS AT ONCE: «12 is divisible by 2 because it is even» — both statements are true and the second proves nothing, being THE SAME THING said twice; «12 is divisible by 4 because it is divisible by 2» — both true again, and the second is WEAKER than the first, so the first does not follow from it. Falsehood has nothing to do with it, and therefore NO COURT OVER TRUTH WOULD EVER CATCH THIS. Three genera by THE STRENGTH OF THE GROUND, all decided by WALKING THE DECLARED RANGE and not by instinct: a CIRCLE (ground and claim are equivalent — the same thing in other words, adding exactly nothing); NO ARGUMENT (the claim does not follow from the ground, which is wider, and an example is named — the commonest error of living reasoning); and an ARGUMENT (the claim follows always and not the other way round, the ground being strictly stronger). The third genus is not there for completeness: without it a reader learns to reject EVERY ground, which is the same trouble from the other end. The properties, the range and the kind of link are taken from the two-way-link world — ONE HOUSE OF WORDS, not three similar declarations. A witness must BE a witness: the number named to prove weakness must satisfy the ground and not the claim; the one named to prove strictness, the reverse.

worlds.name: bothlists
worlds.genre: TWO LISTS — «AND» OVER MEMBERSHIP (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «и там и там» / «in both lists» — ZERO lines. The sets world (`logic_sets`) knows the SIGNS — «{b c} ⊂ {b c e} = T» — and their reading in words; that two lists of names be given in prose and «who is in both» be asked, the corpus says nowhere. «AND» OVER TRUTH AND «AND» OVER MEMBERSHIP ARE ONE LAW AND TWO DEEDS: the boolean world forged this same morning teaches the first — «True and False is False»; here the same «and» walks the lists and the answer is not «yes» or «no» but NAMES. Three genera: in both (intersection), in at least one (union), and in the first and not the second (difference). THE ORDER OF THE ANSWER IS DECLARED, NOT ACCIDENTAL — first by the first list, then the new ones from the second; without a declared order a question would have as many answers as permutations and every one would be right. AN EMPTY ANSWER IS AN ANSWER AND IS SAID IN A WORD: «nobody» is checked as strictly as a list of names, for a reader who has never seen an empty answer will either fall silent before one or invent a name. AND WHERE AN EMPTY ANSWER IS IMPOSSIBLE, THAT IS SAID AND NOT PASSED OVER: the union of two non-empty lists is never empty, and demanding one there would spoil the house for the evenness of a law.

worlds.name: twokeys
worlds.genre: TWO KEYS — THE SECOND IS SILENT WHILE THE FIRST SPEAKS (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «по двум признакам» / «by two keys» — ZERO lines. The corpus orders numbers (`orderforms`), letters (`alphaorder`) and dates (`datecmp`), and every time the key is ONE, composite though it may be. That there are TWO keys and the second enters only where the first says «equal» is said nowhere. THE SECOND KEY IS SILENT WHILE THE FIRST SPEAKS — and therein lies the whole trap: a reader who learned «compare by the second» will reorder where the first has already decided; one who learned «compare by the first» will stand still among equals. The second key is not a SPARE but a SUBORDINATE. THIS IS NOT THE SAME AS THE WEIGHT OF FIELDS IN A DATE: there three numbers belong to ONE thing and the heaviest decides; here two DIFFERENT marks of different kinds — a number and a word — are bound only by a declared order. Three genera by WHAT DECIDED: the first (the numbers differ and the names are never reached); the second (the numbers are equal and the alphabet decides); and BOTH EQUAL — the records are INDISTINGUISHABLE by these keys, and that is said in a word, not settled in silence: a key that does not tell two records apart must admit it aloud. The court checks not only WHICH comes first but WHO DECIDED: to say «the alphabet decided» where the numbers differ is a lie even when the earlier record is named rightly. The alphabet is taken from the alphabetical-order world, not declared a second time.

worlds.name: rolemark
worlds.genre: THE MARK OF THE ROLE — PLACE OR ENDING, AND THE LANGUAGES PART EXACTLY HERE (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «порядок слов меняет смысл» / «word order changes the meaning» — ZERO lines. The word-order world (`wordorder`) knows WHERE THE VERB STANDS and measures it by count; what marks WHO ACTS the corpus says nowhere. «The cat sees the dog» and «the dog sees the cat» are TWO events: in english the PLACE marks the role. «Кошка видит собаку» and «собаку видит кошка» are ONE event: in russian the ENDING marks the role and the place is free. HERE THE LANGUAGE IS THE SUBJECT OF THE SHOW AND NOT ITS SURFACE: the corpus holds a law that a language is not a genus and one genus walks all languages, and this world is a DECLARED EXCEPTION — it is about WHAT SEPARATES the languages, so two of its genera live each in its own. The exception is named aloud and not slipped in silently: a silent exception grows, a declared one is counted. Three genera: place decides (two arrangements, two events); ending decides (two arrangements, one event); and WHO ACTS — a question put to the SWAPPED arrangement, where a reader either follows the mark of their language or misses. The court finds the actor ITSELF by the mark of the language and does not read the claim on the page. The frames carry NO PRONOUN: a pronoun needs a gender the house never declared, and «кошка… он» or «mother… it» would be errors no court here would catch.

worlds.name: homonym
worlds.genre: ONE WORD IN TWO SENSES — TOLD APART BY THE NEIGHBOURS, NOT BY THE WORD (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «омоним» — 4 lines in 451 367, and all four MENTION the word instead of showing the deed. The corpus translates words, declines them and counts their letters, and nowhere says that ONE word can be TWO things. «Коса» in the row of tools and «коса» in the row of hairstyles — one spelling and two things, and the choice can be made ONLY by looking at what stands beside it; a reader who learned the word as a key to the sense will always miss. THE COURT DOES NOT UNDERSTAND SENSE AND DOES NOT UNDERTAKE TO: it checks MEMBERSHIP IN DECLARED ROWS — «коса» is declared in tools and in hairstyles, «топор» only in tools — so everything is checkable by counting and no page asks the instrument for understanding. Three genera: the word stands in TWO declared rows, and both are named; it stands in ONE, so it has one sense and saying «two» would be a lie; and BY THE NEIGHBOURS, where the word is given inside a row and the row is asked — the neighbours are taken UNAMBIGUOUS on purpose, for otherwise there would be nothing to decide by and the question would have two answers. Two strictnesses beyond the answer: the two rows must be exactly those and exactly ALL — naming two of four is passing over two; and the neighbours must belong to the named row and be unambiguous themselves.

worlds.name: condprob
worlds.genre: A SHARE AND ITS BASE (14.09, bought by a zero of the probe). Measured: «условная вероятность» / «conditional probability» — 6 lines in 451 367, and all six MENTION the words. The probability world counts shares (460 lines) and the base is always the same — EVERYONE. That a share can be taken OF A PART, and that everything depends on the choice of base, the corpus says nowhere. A SHARE WITHOUT ITS BASE IS NOT A NUMBER: «nine» by itself is no share, and «9 out of 20» and «9 out of 12» are different shares OF THE SAME COUNT. AND THE MAIN THING: TWO CONDITIONAL SHARES ARE NOT EQUAL TO EACH OTHER — «nine of the twelve girls wear glasses» and «nine of the fifteen glasses-wearers are girls» stand on one number above and different ones below, and a reader who learned the first as the second errs the more surely the more confidently they count. Three genera by the base: the whole set; a PART of the set, said outright («the base is not 20 but 12»); and both conditional shares side by side with their inequality said aloud. Every page carries ALL FOUR numbers of the table and the court recomputes. The numbers of the tail are read as SEPARATE holes and not as references to the opening — with references the frame itself would refuse a page whose base is wrong, and the strongest lie would become UNJUDGEABLE instead of false; a court must be able to call it a lie, not fall silent about it.

worlds.name: adhominem
worlds.genre: AN ARGUMENT ABOUT THE SPEAKER (14.09, the last zero of the probe's sixty-five families). Measured: «к человеку» / «ad hominem» / «переход на личность» — ZERO lines. The unfit-ground world forged the same day catches the WEAK argument and the CIRCULAR one — both taken about the matter. An argument taken NOT ABOUT THE MATTER AT ALL the corpus names nowhere. AN ARGUMENT ABOUT THE SPEAKER CAN BE TRUE AND STILL NOT TOUCH THE MATTER: «he was wrong yesterday» may be plain truth and says nothing of whether today's statement holds. Falsehood has nothing to do with it — as with the circle and the weak ground — for the unfitness lies not in the argument's truth but in WHAT IT IS ABOUT. THE COURT DOES NOT UNDERSTAND «IS IT RELEVANT» AND DOES NOT UNDERTAKE TO: it looks at WHICH DECLARED ROW the argument was taken from — the properties of the THING or the properties of the SPEAKER — and that is enough. Three genera: about the matter; about the speaker and not touching it; and ABOUT THE SPEAKER BUT TO THE MATTER — the boundary without which the house would teach trusting no one: some properties of a speaker DO bear on the matter — he stood on the bridge during the test, he held the bucket and counted aloud — and that is testimony, not a turn upon the person. Without the third genus a reader learns to reject every reference to the speaker, which is the same trouble from the other end: then no witnesses, no eyewitnesses and no counters remain.

worlds.name: dilemma
worlds.genre: THE FALSE DILEMMA — THE LIST, NOT THE CONNECTIVE (14.09, the last zero of the probe's sixty-six families). Measured: «ложная дилемма» / «false dilemma» / «третьего не дано» — ZERO lines. The corpus knows the connectives («or» in boolean expressions), knows the choice of an operation (`opchoice`), knows refusal for want of data — and nowhere says that THE LIST OF OUTCOMES ITSELF CAN BE INCOMPLETE. «EITHER THIS OR THAT» IS A CLAIM ABOUT THE WORLD, NOT ABOUT LOGIC: the connective «or» is always sound; what is unsound is the LIST it is attached to. And that is checked not by reasoning but by RECOUNTING — how many outcomes are declared and how many are named. Three genera: ALL NAMED (two outcomes declared and both named — an honest dilemma; the genus is needed because without it a reader learns that every either-or is a trick); A THIRD EXISTS (three or more declared, two named, and the missed one named outright); and THE MIDDLE, where the outcomes are the edges of a SCALE and what is missed is not an outcome but A WHOLE ROW, named by count. THE COURT DOES NOT DECIDE WHETHER A LIST IS COMPLETE AT ALL — that cannot be settled by counting: completeness here is a DECLARATION and not a truth about the world, and the court matches what is named against the declared set. The two named must be the FIRST TWO of the set, otherwise the «missed» one would be named from among those already named.

worlds.name: addshare
worlds.genre: ADDING SHARES — shares add only when brought to one denominator. Measured 11.09 across the show worlds: «1/2 + 1/3», «1/3 + 1/4» — NOT ONE occurrence; subtracting shares — NONE; the least common multiple — NONE. Adding shares with the SAME denominator is there (108 lines), and that makes the hole the more dangerous: the easy case is shown and the hard one — where the rule actually lives — is not shown at all. A READER WHO HAS SEEN ONLY «1/5 + 2/5 = 3/5» WILL ADD «1/2 + 1/3» THE SAME WAY AND GET «2/5». A rule shown only where it is not needed teaches one not to know it. Four genera, and the first is here for the sake of the second: SAME («1/5 + 2/5: the denominator is the same, and the NUMERATORS are added: 1 + 2 = 3, and it gives 3/5»); DIFFERENT («1/2 + 1/3: bring them to the common denominator 6: 1 × 3 = 3, and 1 × 2 = 2, and 3 + 2 = 5, and it gives 5/6»); SUBTRACT; GREATER («2/3 + 3/4: … 8 + 9 = 17, and it gives 17/12, and that is greater than one: 17 = 12 × 1 + 5»). The fourth joins the house to its neighbour: a sum of shares often runs past the unit, and without showing this the house would suggest that shares always add up to a share; the split into whole and remainder is taken by the same ledger the house of the fraction and the unit lives by. DENOMINATORS ARE NOT ADDED, AND THAT IS SHOWN RATHER THAN FORBIDDEN: in the first genus one sees the move «numerators are added» with the denominator unchanged; in the second, that the denominators must first be made equal — the prohibition follows from these two pages by itself. Subtraction is written only where the result is positive: negative shares are another house's subject. The common denominator is taken as in the house of comparing shares — the greater if it divides by the smaller, else the product; the least common multiple would be a second law on one page.

worlds.name: age
worlds.genre: age and the shift of time: the difference between two ages does NOT change when both move forward or back — the law a corpus of single facts cannot teach; ages now, the shift in both directions, the multiple relation with its ground, the multiple in the future built so it is true by construction, and a refusal when nothing is said about the person asked

worlds.name: aggregate
worlds.genre: THE AGGREGATE — A FACT OF SEVERAL BEARERS AND THE FOUR HEADS THAT ASK FOR IT, declared until 12.09 in six words: «aggregate genus: a fact of a plural bearer». Measured 12.09: 430 lines, English only, and EVERY ONE of them asks — 430 questions, 215 carrying the arithmetic beside the answer. The frame is one: two bearers hold the same kind of thing, and the question is their TOTAL («Carla has 9 paintings. Felix has 6 paintings. how many paintings do Carla and Felix have in all?»). What the world buys is not the addition — the corpus adds in a hundred worlds — but THE HEAD OF THE QUESTION, and the heads are four and counted: «together» 216, «altogether» 110, «in all» 101, «in total» 71. A READER TRAINED ON ONE HEAD STANDS MUTE BEFORE THE OTHER THREE: the arithmetic is the same and the phrase is not, and it is the phrase that is asked. The holding is said three ways as well — «has» 430, «hold» 151, «have» 135 — so that the bearer's verb is not a single habit either. AND THE BEARERS ARE NOT ALWAYS TWO: 360 lines hold two and SEVENTY hold three («Carla has 5 balloons. Grace has 3 balloons. Felix has 1 balloon…»). This measurement corrected the first draft of THIS VERY DECLARATION, which said «two bearers» from memory — the probe `tools/world_probe.py`, forged out of five identical measurements made by hand, caught the sixth on its first run. A TOOL BUILT FROM THE HAND'S REPETITION PAYS FOR ITSELF THE FIRST TIME THE HAND IS WRONG. Eight bearers (Ava, Ben, Carla, Dan, Elena, Felix, Grace, Hugo) and 125 distinct things carry the frame, and the things are deliberately odd — chimichangas, vlogs, calories, seconds — so that no reader can answer from the meaning of the noun instead of the counting: A THING WHOSE NAME TELLS NOTHING FORCES THE ANSWER TO COME FROM THE NUMBER. Boundary: whole totals only and no negative value in 430 lines, both measured by the manifest's own detectors.

worlds.name: algebra
worlds.genre: ЗНАК МАТЕМАТИКИ, НАЗВАННЫЙ НА ТРЁХ ЯЗЫКАХ, И ТОЖДЕСТВО, ПРОВЕРЕННОЕ ПОДСТАНОВКОЙ: «\gamma называется гамма», «\Gamma heisst grosses gamma», «\emptyset is called empty set» — и рядом «при x = …», «чему равно …». Имя знака есть ОБЪЯВЛЕНИЕ традиции, а не правило; тождество же покупается счётом: подставь число и пересчитай. Потому мир держит русский, английский и немецкий разом (замер 12.09: 1744 строки, 956 равенств, 604 сложения, 452 умножения, 549 вопросов; 164 раза «называется/heisst/called»; читают formula, arith, indu).

worlds.name: algorithms
worlds.genre: ДЕЙСТВИЕ НАД СПИСКОМ, НАЗВАННОЕ И ПОКАЗАННОЕ: «разворот 3 1 2 даёт 2 1 3», «what is the minimum of 3 1 2?», «чему равна длина 3 1 2?», наибольший общий делитель. Мир не пишет программы, а называет ЧТО ДАЁТ действие на этом самом списке — и потому проверяется пересчётом. Ни одного знака действия на 2264 строки: список и его итог сказаны СЛОВАМИ, а не формулой (замер 12.09: 644 вопроса, 92 отказа, русских и английских ровно поровну — по 1132; читает почти один `algo`). СОСЕД И РАЗЛИЧИЕ: `verbal` тоже зовёт действие словом, но словом английским и о ПАРЕ ЧИСЕЛ («9 minus 4»); здесь слово называет ход по ВСЕМУ СПИСКУ, и итог его есть новый список либо одно число из многих.

worlds.name: amend
worlds.genre: SELF-CORRECTION — check YOUR OWN answer and say whether you were wrong. Measured 11.09: «я ошибся» stands in the canon ONLY AS AN APOLOGY — in the dialogue world and the self-model house («извини, я ошибся. всё в порядке», «what is «извини, я ошибся»? — an apology»). An admission of error IN COUNTING, with a check and the right answer, is made by not one line; «была ошибка», «верный ответ», «i was wrong» occur NOT ONCE. AN ORGANISM THAT CAN APOLOGISE AND CANNOT RECOUNT APOLOGISES INSTEAD OF CORRECTING. Three genera, all checked by recomputing both steps: WRONG («i was asked what 2 + 3 × 4 is, and i said 20. i check: multiplication goes before addition, and 3 × 4 = 12, and 2 + 12 = 14. i was wrong: it is 14»); NOT WRONG (the SAME check with the other outcome); and REASONING («i said 14. that is right, but my reasoning was wrong: i said addition goes first, while multiplication goes first»). The first two are a minimal pair: the check is ONE AND THE SAME and its outcome differs — without the second the house would teach that a check always ends in repentance, and the check would become a rite. A CHECK THAT ALWAYS FINDS AN ERROR IS NOT A CHECK. The third is deeper than the first two and the house is built three-fold for its sake: the answer is right and the reasoning is wrong, AND THAT DOES NOT COUNT. One who got fourteen by adding before multiplying got it by accident, and will err the next time. A RIGHT ANSWER DOES NOT JUSTIFY A WRONG PATH. The mistaken answer is named BY A NUMBER and not by an equation, and that was bought by the arithmetic court: the first draft wrote «i said that 2 + 3 × 4 = 20» and was called false — rightly, for that is an ASSERTED equation and not one quoted by a question, and the court's quotation window opens only on a question. Now the error stands as a number, and no false equation appears in the canon at all. TO SHOW AN ERROR ONE NEED NOT ASSERT IT. The numbers are taken from the house of the order of operations: the left-to-right error is the very one that house was built for, and here it gains a second surface — not «how it should be» but «i checked myself».

worlds.name: analog
worlds.genre: LIKENESS — analogy and its CHECK, not its feeling. The fourth debt of the reasoning map, closed the same way as the other three: the row is one where the relation is CHECKED rather than declared. «2 is to 6 as 5 is to 15» is true by the cross product, and the third form of the house is the house: «2 is to 6 as 5 is to 12? no: 2 × 12 = 24, and 6 × 5 = 30» shows the CHECK, without which analogy stays what it usually is — a feeling of similarity with no right to a conclusion. An organism that learns the first two forms finds likenesses everywhere; one that learns the third can REJECT them and can name what it rejected them by. The court demands of a refusal that the two named products DIFFER: a refusal naming equal products would reject a TRUE analogy while displaying the correct test — a lie that teaches both the method and distrust of the method at once. Generic likeness («a shark is to fishes as an oak is to trees») is a named debt: it needs plural class forms the world-facts house does not declare.

worlds.name: anaphora
worlds.genre: ANAPHORA — the second mention of a person, and TWO WAYS of carrying it. The measure over the svod: pronominal reference lives in Russian (746 «она», 873 «он»), English (608/547), German (324/586), French (137) — and is nearly or wholly absent in Spanish (0 «ella»), Italian (0 «lei») and Polish (0 «ona»). Three languages of nine never show a second mention. AND THAT IS NOT ONE GAP BUT TWO STRUCTURES MIXED INSIDE ONE ZERO: Spanish, Italian and Polish DROP the subject — the second mention is carried by the ENDING OF THE VERB, and writing «ella dio» there would be unidiomatic. A corpus that added pronouns to them would teach wrong speech; a corpus that added nothing would teach no reference at all. The house declares WHICH languages carry the mention in the verb, and the court holds it to that declaration. Three oracles on one line: the subtraction, the count form of the thing at EACH of the three numbers, and the agreement of the NAME with the gender of the frame — with the last check silent exactly where a language drops the subject, since there the two frames coincide word for word and the gender is not expressed at all. Silence there is not a hole but the shape of that language.

worlds.name: angle
worlds.genre: СУММА УГЛОВ — СТО ВОСЕМЬДЕСЯТ У ВСЯКОГО ТРЕУГОЛЬНИКА, КАКОВ БЫ ОН НИ БЫЛ. Замер 12.09 по всему своду в 39 МБ: «сумма углов» — НОЛЬ вхождений; свод знает слово «треугольник» (452 строки) и «прямой угол» (9), считает площади и периметры — и ни разу не говорит того первого, что знает о треугольнике всякий. СУММА УГЛОВ ЕСТЬ СВОЙСТВО ЧИСЛА СТОРОН, А НЕ РАЗМЕРА И НЕ ФОРМЫ. Восемь родов, 74 страницы, два языка: сумма треугольника, третий угол по двум («180 − 50 − 70 = 60: два угла держат третий, и измерять его нечего»), общий закон «(n − 2) × 180» для трёх, четырёх, пяти, шести и восьми сторон, два острых при прямом. ДВА РОДА СУТЬ ОДНА ЛОВУШКА, ПОКАЗАННАЯ ОБЕИМИ СТОРОНАМИ: «фигура иная, а число то же» рядом с «у четырёхугольника 360, А НЕ 180 — сумма зависит от числа сторон». ПОСТОЯНСТВО, ПОКАЗАННОЕ БЕЗ СВОЕЙ ГРАНИЦЫ, ЧИТАЕТСЯ КАК ВСЕОБЩЕЕ: ЧИСЛО 180 ПРИНАДЛЕЖИТ НЕ ФИГУРЕ ВООБЩЕ, А ФИГУРЕ О ТРЁХ СТОРОНАХ. Есть и род ГРАНИЦЫ: двух прямых углов в треугольнике не бывает, ибо 90 + 90 = 180 и третьему не осталось бы ничего, — и граница эта не запрет, а СЛЕДСТВИЕ СЧЁТА. Это the forty-ninth trap of the series — сумма углов, принятая за свойство размера. Углы целые, и самопроверка требует, чтобы треугольники РАЗЛИЧАЛИСЬ формой: иначе постоянство суммы не видно вовсе.

worlds.name: beforetails
worlds.genre: THE TAIL THAT POINTS BACKWARD — «how many did I have TO BEGIN WITH?» (05.09, the third gate of the silence atlas by d5's measure: 24 rows of the grove and 23 of the reader stop at an unbought before-tail). A story told forward and asked BACKWARDS: an act (gave away, bought, spent money), the state after it, and a question ending with one of FIVE tails per language — «to begin with», «in the beginning», «initially», «at the start», «before that»; «сначала», «вначале», «изначально», «поначалу», «до того» — because the market must buy the WORDS and not one phrase. The act is inverted by the sign of its kind: what was given away is added back, what was bought is taken away, what was spent is added back to what is left. First person throughout, so no name declines in nine languages; goods, currency and the counting rule are the price house's (tools/beforetails.py). CLOSED world.

worlds.name: behavior
worlds.genre: BEHAVIOURAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL LAWS — the cause of an act and the question about it (the owner's order, 04.09, item 3: «понимать базовые поведенческие и психологические законы»). Not psychology in general and not quotations from the shelf, but shows of this house: six genera named by the order — fatigue → errors, need → action, emotion → its ground, intention → deed, habit → repetition, attention → omission. Every consequence is COMPARATIVE («ошибается ЧАЩЕ», «makes MORE mistakes»): «the tired man errs» is false as a law about a man, «the tired man errs more often» is true as a law about frequency, and the corpus may not teach the first. Three forms: the rule, the QUESTION about the cause, and the law generalized over cases. Nine languages; the subject is always a NAME, never a pronoun, so no referent is ever left hanging.

worlds.name: both
worlds.genre: TWO CONDITIONS — an inference for which ONE ground is not enough. All the reasoning of the canon runs from a single premise: the house of strict inference says «12 is divisible by 4, therefore 12 is divisible by 2» — one premise; the house of exclusion narrows a range by denials, but its conclusion rests on exhaustion, not on ADDING grounds. Measured 10.09 over the connectives of reasoning: «во-первых» — NONE, «во-вторых» — NONE, «например» — NONE, «однако» — NONE. The canon does not enumerate grounds, because one has always sufficed. AN INFERENCE THAT NEEDS ONE GROUND DOES NOT TEACH CHECKING THE SECOND — and in life the conditions are two and more, each able to fail on its own. Four genera, and they are the FULL TRUTH TABLE OF CONJUNCTION SHOWN BY COUNTING, not by letters: BOTH («does 14 fit? first, 14 is even: 14 = 2 × 7. second, 14 is greater than 10. both conditions hold»); FIRST FAILS («15 is odd: 15 = 2 × 7 + 1, though 15 is greater than 10»); SECOND FAILS («8 is even: 8 = 2 × 4, but 8 is not greater than 10»); NEITHER («7 is odd … and 7 is not greater than 10»). The second and third are a minimal pair, without which the house would be half of itself: now one condition fails, now the other, and the verdict is the same — a reader who sees both cannot decide that only the beginning of the check matters. The fourth is not superfluous though it seems obvious: without it the table is incomplete, and an incomplete table teaches guessing the missing cell. The words «though» and «but» stand not for ornament: they carry CONCESSION — the acknowledgement of a ground that still does not save. Both conditions are checked BY COUNTING and not by declaration: parity by the writing «n = 2 × k» or «n = 2 × k + 1», magnitude by comparison with the threshold. There are three thresholds, and that was bought by the measure of mass: with a single threshold of 10 the cells «second fails» and «neither» gathered five and four pages — fewer than nine, that is UNBUYABLE, for there are only nine numbers below ten. A TABLE WHOSE CELL IS SHOWN FOUR TIMES TEACHES THREE CELLS OUT OF FOUR.

worlds.name: bound
worlds.genre: THE BOUND OF A MAGNITUDE — not every valid subtraction is a possible action. Measured 10.09 across all show worlds: the canon holds 997 tasks of the shape «there were N, M were given away», and IN NOT ONE is M greater than N. It carefully avoids the impossible situation and so never teaches it to be RECOGNISED: there is not a single negative count of things, and the words «cannot take», «impossible to give» do not occur at all. THIS IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF REFUSAL THAN DIVISION BY ZERO, and the difference is the point. There the action did not exist at all: no number multiplied by zero gives six. Here the action exists and the arithmetic is right — «12 − 15 = −3» is true in the world of numbers, and the signed world shows it 360 times. But there are never minus three nuts. A MAGNITUDE HAS A BOUND, AND ARITHMETIC DOES NOT KNOW IT. Four genera, all checked by TWO computations — a comparison and a subtraction: POSSIBLE («taking 5 out of 12 is possible: 5 is less than 12, and 7 nuts remain: 12 − 5 = 7»); EXACTLY ALL («taking 12 out of 12 is possible: 12 is not greater than 12, and 0 nuts remain») — the bound shown FROM THE INSIDE, without which the reader may decide that «as many as there are» is forbidden too; IMPOSSIBLE («taking 15 out of 12 is impossible: 15 is greater than 12»); and NUMBER («in numbers 12 − 15 = −3, but there are never −3 nuts, and so taking 15 out of 12 is impossible») — the only genus that says WHY it is impossible while the arithmetic is right. TWO TRUE STATEMENTS MAY CONTRADICT EACH OTHER IF THEY ARE ABOUT DIFFERENT THINGS. The comparison comes BEFORE the action, and that is the whole subject of the house: the first genus does not repeat the story world («there were 12, 5 were given, 7 remain») — it adds the step that world lacks, a check of possibility BEFORE the count; without it the third genus would be a prohibition from nowhere and the fourth a sophism. Things are masculine only and the action impersonal («взяли»): a feminine noun would bend the adjective the house does not declare, and a person would demand verb agreement by gender, which is the subject of other houses. The English verb agrees with the count («1 nut was taken», «3 nuts were taken») — the first draft wrote «were» as a literal and produced «1 nut were taken»; Russian had nothing to agree here, and so the error was visible only in the other language.

worlds.name: calendar_langs
worlds.genre: THE WEEK IN EIGHT LANGUAGES (the owner's word: every language in surplus; the calendar world's cycle shows «3 days after tuesday comes friday» are the shows from which the organism buys the weekly cycle without names and without the seven — holon's ЦИКЛ): «3 Tage nach Dienstag kommt Freitag.», «welcher Tag kommt 2 Tage nach Donnerstag? 2 Tage nach Donnerstag kommt Samstag.», «quel jour vient 2 jours après jeudi ? …», «¿qué día viene 2 días después del jueves? … viene el sábado.», «che giorno viene 2 giorni dopo giovedì? …», «que dia vem 2 dias depois de quinta-feira? …», «welke dag komt 2 dagen na donderdag? …», «jaki dzień przypada 2 dni po czwartku? 2 dni po czwartku przypada sobota.» (Polish locative after «po»), «perşembeden 2 gün sonra hangi gün gelir? perşembeden 2 gün sonra cumartesi gelir.» (Turkish ablative); the house of weekday phrases (tools/calforms.py) holds the names with their oblique forms and the count forms of «day»; the court counts the cycle itself

worlds.name: ceilfloor
worlds.genre: TWO ANSWERS TO ONE DIVISION — THE REMAINDER DECIDES WHICH WAY TO ROUND, AND THE QUESTION DECIDES THE REMAINDER'S USE. Measured 11.09 across the 251 show worlds (429 194 lines): «не хватит», «понадобится ещё», «нужно N коробок», «потребуется» — NONE; «сколько полных», «полностью заполн», «full boxes» — NONE. The corpus knows division with a remainder — 966 pages of the house `remdiv` and 320 of `remainders_langs` — and never once asks WHAT TO DO with that remainder. It declares the remainder and stops there. THE REMAINDER IS COUNTED AND NOT USED: THE CORPUS CARRIES THE DIVISION TO ITS END AND HALTS BEFORE THE QUESTION FOR WHOSE SAKE IT DIVIDED. The twenty-third trap of the series, and it differs from every earlier one in having TWO RIGHT ANSWERS: 53 sweets at 20 to a box is both 2 boxes and 3 boxes, according to what was asked. Every earlier trap of the series parted the right from the false; this one parts the right from ANOTHER RIGHT. ONE DIVISION, TWO QUESTIONS, TWO DIFFERENT RIGHT ANSWERS: THE DIFFERENCE IS MADE BY THE QUESTION, NOT BY THE NUMBER. Four genera: UP («53 sweets are put 20 to a box; to fit them all one needs 3 boxes, for 53 ÷ 20 gives 2 and a remainder of 13»); DOWN («2 boxes will be filled to the top, and 13 sweets will be left over») — the trap; NO REMAINDER («40 sweets at 20: one needs 2 boxes, and 2 boxes will be filled, for there is no remainder»); TWO ANSWERS («one division, two questions … 3 − 2 = 1»). The third genus is the CONTROL over the first two: without it a reader would conclude that the two questions ALWAYS give different answers, and that would be false — at remainder 0 they agree. A TRAP SHOWN WITHOUT ITS OWN EXCEPTION BECOMES A NEW SUPERSTITION; A RULE WITHOUT ITS EXCEPTION IS READ AS A LAW AND IS FALSE EXACTLY WHERE THE EXCEPTION IS. The control is forged on the SAME divisors as the trap — different numbers would have driven the rule and its exception apart into different tasks. The fourth genus states the law AS A DEED: both halves of one division stand side by side and their difference is written as an equality, «3 − 2 = 1» — the single unit by which the answers part. A QUOTIENT WITH A REMAINDER IS NOT WRITTEN WITH AN EQUALS SIGN, and that is a law of the corpus and not a taste of this house: «53 ÷ 20 = 2» is FALSE, and the court of arithmetic would rightly call it so. It is written «gives 2 and a remainder of 13», and the check is set down in true equalities: 20 × 2 = 40, and 40 + 13 = 53 — the same writing by which the house `remdiv` lives. The counting forms are taken from the table of the language («2 коробки», «13 конфет», «1 книга»), and the verb beside the remainder stands in the singular («останется»), for it must stand rightly at 1 as well as at 13. ВОПРОСНЫЙ РОД ДОБАВЛЕН 12.09 ПО УКАЗАНИЮ ПРИБОРА ШИРОТЫ: мир нёс НОЛЬ вопросительных знаков — он только утверждал. МИР БЕЗ ВОПРОСНОЙ ПОВЕРХНОСТИ ПОКАЗЫВАЕТ ОТВЕТ, НЕ ПОКАЗЫВАЯ ЗАДАЧИ.
